title: Use Google Trending Search in the Firefox Address Bar
description: Learn how to enable and use Google trending searches in Oasis's address bar, discover current trends, and understand how this feature enhances your browsing experience while maintaining privacy.
content:
Oasis browser, built on Firefox technology, includes Google trending search functionality in the address bar that displays the most popular and frequently searched terms on Google at any given moment. This feature, when enabled, offers real-time insights into current trends and popular topics, making your search experience more dynamic and relevant.

Pro Tip

Google trending searches can help you discover breaking news, popular topics, and current events. They're designed to enhance your search experience while respecting your privacy preferences.

What Are Google Trending Searches?

Google trending searches highlight the topics that are currently capturing widespread attention. These trends are determined by the volume and frequency of searches over a short period. By enabling trending searches, you can stay updated with the latest news, events and viral topics directly from your Oasis address bar.

Current Events

Trending searches reflect what's happening now:

  • Breaking News: Latest news stories and developments
  • Popular Topics: Currently trending subjects and discussions
  • Seasonal Events: Holidays, sports events, and cultural moments
  • Viral Content: Popular videos, memes, and social media trends

Search Patterns

Suggestions based on collective search behavior:

  • Global Trends: What people worldwide are searching for
  • Regional Interest: Popular searches in your geographic area
  • Category Trends: Trending topics in specific categories
  • Real-time Updates: Suggestions that update throughout the day
Availability Note

This feature is currently available to a limited set of users, including users in the United States, starting in Firefox version 118. The feature is available where Google makes Trending Search available, which is subject to change and not determined by Mozilla or Oasis.

How to Use Google Trending Search

Step 1: Access the Address Bar

To use Google trending searches in Oasis:

  1. At the top of the screen, click on the address bar
  2. The address bar will become active and ready for input
  3. You may see a drop-down menu appear automatically

Step 2: View Trending Searches

Once you click the address bar:

  • A drop-down menu will appear
  • It displays the latest trending search terms based on your area
  • Trending searches are typically marked or highlighted
  • You'll see multiple trending topics to choose from

Step 3: Select a Trending Search

To use a trending search term:

  1. Click on a trending search term that interests you
  2. You'll be redirected to the Search Engine Results Page (SERP)
  3. The search will be performed automatically
  4. You can then browse the results for that trending topic

Enabling Google Trending Search

Automatic Availability

Google trending searches are typically enabled by default when available:

  • Default State: Usually enabled automatically if the feature is available
  • No Manual Setup: No additional configuration required in most cases
    • Version Dependent: Available in Firefox version 118 and later
  • Regional Availability: Depends on your location and Google's service availability

Verifying the Feature

To check if trending searches are working:

  1. Click on your address bar
  2. Look for trending search suggestions in the dropdown
  3. Check if you see current trending topics
  4. Verify that clicking on them performs searches

If Not Working

If trending searches aren't appearing:

  • Check Version: Ensure you're using Firefox 118+ or equivalent Oasis version
  • Location Check: Verify you're in a supported region
  • Google Services: Ensure Google services are accessible
  • Browser Updates: Update to the latest version if needed

Disabling Google Trending Search

Method 1: Through Search Results

To disable trending searches when they appear:

  1. Hover your mouse over a trending search term
  2. A menu button will appear on the right-hand side
  3. Click the menu button to reveal options
  4. Select "Don't show trending searches"

Method 2: Settings Configuration

Alternative way to disable the feature:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Navigate to the "Search" section
  3. Find "Address Bar" or "Awesome Bar" settings
  4. Look for trending search options
  5. Disable the feature if available

Confirmation

After disabling trending searches:

  • Confirmation Message: A confirmation will appear indicating the change
  • Immediate Effect: Trending searches won't appear in future searches
  • Re-enabling: You can re-enable through settings if desired
  • Persistence: The setting will be remembered across browser sessions

Benefits of Google Trending Search

Effortless Discovery

How trending searches enhance your browsing:

  • Time Saving: No need to think of search terms
  • Current Awareness: Stay informed about trending topics
  • Content Discovery: Find content you might not have searched for
  • Breaking News: Access to latest news and developments

Local Insights

Regional relevance and community awareness:

  • Community Trends: See what's trending in your area
  • Regional News: Local events and developments
  • Cultural Relevance: Topics relevant to your community
  • Geographic Context: Location-based trending information
Enhanced Experience

Google trending searches transform your address bar into a window to your region's buzzing conversations and trends, making it easier to stay connected with what's happening around you.

Privacy and Data Considerations

Data Collection

What information is used for trending searches:

  • Aggregated Data: Based on popular searches from a broad audience
  • No Personal History: Your individual search history is not used
  • Regional Data: General location information for regional trends
  • Anonymous Patterns: Search patterns without personal identification

Privacy Protection

How your privacy is maintained:

  • No Personal Tracking: Mozilla doesn't collect personal information
  • No Search History: Your searches aren't tracked for suggestions
  • User Control: You can disable the feature entirely
  • Transparent Policies: Clear information about data usage

Mozilla's Commitment

Mozilla's privacy principles:

  • Privacy First: Built with privacy as a core principle
  • User Control: You decide what features to enable
  • Transparency: Clear about what data is used and how
  • No Profiling: No user profiling or targeted advertising
Privacy Note

Enabling trending searches does not affect your search privacy. The trending searches shown are not based on your personal search history but on popular searches from a broad audience. Mozilla does not collect any personal information or track your individual searches.

Customization and Control

Current Limitations

What you can and cannot customize:

  • No Specific Customization: Currently no options to customize trending searches
  • Automatic Generation: Searches are automatically generated based on your area
  • Popularity Based: Based on most popular search queries at the time
  • Real-time Updates: Continuously updated throughout the day

Future Possibilities

Potential customization options that may be added:

  • Category Filtering: Choose specific categories of trending topics
  • Frequency Control: Adjust how often suggestions update
  • Regional Preferences: More granular location control
    • Personalization: Tailored suggestions based on interests

User Control

What you can control now:

  • Enable/Disable: Turn the feature on or off completely
  • Ignore Suggestions: Choose not to use trending searches
  • Browser Settings: Control through general browser settings
  • Privacy Controls: Use privacy settings to limit data collection

Troubleshooting Common Issues

Trending Searches Not Appearing

If you don't see trending searches:

  1. Check Version: Ensure you're using Firefox 118+ or equivalent
  2. Verify Location: Confirm you're in a supported region
  3. Check Settings: Verify the feature isn't disabled
  4. Restart Browser: Restart Oasis to refresh the feature
  5. Update Browser: Ensure you have the latest version

Feature Not Working

If trending searches aren't functioning:

  • Internet Connection: Check your internet connection
  • Google Services: Ensure Google services are accessible
  • Browser Cache: Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Privacy Settings: Check if privacy settings are blocking the feature

Performance Issues

If the feature causes problems:

  • Disable Feature: Turn off trending searches temporarily
  • Check Extensions: Disable conflicting browser extensions
  • Monitor Performance: Watch for any performance impact
  • Contact Support: Reach out to Mozilla support if issues persist

Best Practices

Privacy Best Practices

Maintaining privacy while using trending searches:

  • Review Settings: Regularly check your privacy settings
  • Use Private Browsing: Consider private mode for sensitive searches
  • Clear Data Regularly: Clear browsing data periodically
  • Monitor Permissions: Check what permissions the feature requires

Usage Best Practices

Getting the most out of trending searches:

  • Stay Informed: Use to discover current events and trends
  • Explore Topics: Click on interesting suggestions to learn more
    • Verify Information: Check multiple sources for trending topics
  • Be Critical: Evaluate the credibility of trending content

Content Quality

Ensuring high-quality search results:

  • Multiple Sources: Check various sources for trending topics
  • Fact Checking: Verify information from reliable sources
  • Report Issues: Report inappropriate or misleading content
  • Stay Updated: Keep your browser updated for better filtering

Additional Resources

For more information about Google trending searches and Firefox features, we recommend:

Official Mozilla Documentation - Complete guide from Mozilla support

Firefox Awesome Bar Guide - Complete awesome bar documentation

Search Suggestions Guide - Information about search suggestions

Search Engine Settings - Configure your default search engine

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Oasis's implementation of Google trending searches in the address bar. The functionality and privacy practices described are specific to Oasis's approach, which is built on Firefox technology. Other browsers may have different trending search features, privacy policies, and customization options.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it shares similar address bar features and can benefit from Mozilla's Google trending search integration. The availability and functionality of this feature may vary based on your location and the specific version of Oasis you're using.
